Suppress statistics for small enrollment groups

Source: R/utils_enrollment.R
suppress_small_n_enroll.Rd

Sets specified numeric columns to NA_real_ for rows where the count column falls below min_n. Adds a logical suppressed column to the returned data frame.

Usage

suppress_small_n_enroll(df, n_col, min_n, suppress_cols)

Arguments

df

A data frame.

n_col

Character scalar. Name of the column holding the group count.

min_n

Integer. Groups below this size are suppressed.

suppress_cols

Character vector of column names to set to NA.

Value

df with suppress_cols set to NA_real_ where suppressed, plus a logical suppressed column.

Details

Uses base-R row indexing rather than dplyr::across() + dplyr::if_else() to avoid the NA-assignment-into-list-column ambiguity documented in CLAUDE.md (same pattern as compute_distributions() small-n suppression).
